title: [Hinglish - Instagram/YouTube only] Agent pull request - merge se pehle 4 checks
content:
GitHub ke Octoverse 2026 report mein
ek line hai jo aaj ke demo ka reason hai.
By September 2026,
more than 40% of pull requests on GitHub
started with an agent's 1st draft.
March mein ye 17% tha.
September mein 110 million aise pull requests,
about 6 times March ka volume.
Ye GitHub ka number hai,
aur ye detected agent 1st drafts hain.
Har AI suggestion is count mein nahi hai.

Aaj main screen pe dikhata hoon
ki aisa 1 pull request
merge se pehle kaise check karte hain.
You only need the diff, the tests, and 4 questions.

Check number 1. Files.
GitHub kehta hai agent-started pull requests
about 87% time multiple files chhedte hain.
Bina detected agent ke ye about 79% hai.
To pehle file list dekho.
Jo file aapne maangi hi nahi,
use alag se padho.
Extra file often hides the bug.

Check number 2. The claim.
Agent ne description mein kya likha,
aur diff mein kya badla.
Dono match karo, line by line.
"Fixed the login bug"
tabhi sach hai
jab login wala test fail se pass ho.
A sentence in the summary
is not the change.

Check number 3. Tests.
Purane tests pass hain ya nahi.
Naya test us case ko cover karta hai
jo tootna chahiye tha.
Agar test nahi hai,
merge mat karo.
Ask the agent to add the test,
phir test ko khud chalao.
Do not trust a green check
you did not run.

Check number 4. Secrets aur scope.
API key, password, token,
diff mein kahin plain text to nahi.
Aur change sirf us folder mein hai
jiska aapne kaam maanga tha.
Agent kabhi helpful banne ke chakkar mein
extra file bhi badal deta hai.
That extra edit is how small bugs ship.

Maan lo aapke paas
1 chhota signup form ka pull request hai.
Agent ne 6 files chhedi.
Aapne 2 maangi thi.
Pehle woh 4 extra files padho.
Phir signup test chalao.
Phir diff mein password ya key dhoondo.
Ye 10 minute ka kaam hai.
Ye hi review hai.

Mera take simple hai.
Agent pehla draft likh sakta hai.
Merge ka button aapka hai.
Jo diff aapne padha nahi,
wo aapka code nahi hai,
agent ka code hai,
aapka naam uske upar hai.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
